desc: Project Rogue turned the Revolution DI platform into the lightest 308 semi auto rifle on the market. The result is a sub-6 lb. 308 rifle packed with proprietary and patented innovations. The Rogue features a forged receiver set; 12.50" match grade stainless steel barrel; Keylock DI BCG; ambidextrous selector; Strike Eagle ambidextrous charging handle; Renegade rail & oversized heatsink barrel nut and Micro B muzzle brake.
